newsitem.title: USA: AEP sees 1,020 MW Mich. Cook 1 back today.
newsitem.headline: AEP sees 1,020 MW Mich. Cook 1 back today.

text.p: American Electric Power Co's (AEP) 1,020 megawatt (MW) Cook 1 nuclear power plant was expected to return to service later today after being shut this past weekend, a company spokesman said on Monday.
"Hopefully by the end of the day, it'll be back up," said spokesman Bill Schalk.
This confirmed the estimated restart time reported earlier Monday by the Nuclear Regulatory Commission.
The unit in Bridgman, Mich., tripped off line when lightning hit an offsite transmission system, he said.
Cook 1 is operated by Indiana Michigan Power Co, a subsidiary of American Electric Power.
